name: DSW — Digital Science Workstation
description: A native host that runs C++/HTML experiment plugins: drop a bundle in a folder and it appears in the launcher. The browser is the GUI, the heavy math runs native. Ships with nine experiments — reaction–diffusion, a wave tank, an EBL pattern-transfer simulator, and a 2D-materials set covering molecular dynamics on CPU and GPU, lattice vibrations, moiré bubbles and superlubricity.
note: Native desktop app — download a build for Windows, macOS or Linux, or compile it yourself; the experiments then run in your browser.
